rationale: The bid-ask spread of 187 bps is extremely wide, creating an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any directional trade difficult to profit from. The ATR on 5-minute bars is only $0.095, which is tiny relative to the spread, meaning the instrument would need to move many multiples of its recent volatility just to overcome transaction costs. Additionally, with only ~50K shares traded and the price sitting at 19.6% of today's range after a large gap-down, there is insufficient liquidity and directional clarity to justify a position.
